title: A time for celebration
description: As part of Star Wars' 20th anniversary celebration in 1997, A New Hope was digitally remastered and re-released to theaters, along with its two sequels, under the campaign title The Star Wars Trilogy: Special Edition. These Special Edition versions contained computer-generated visual shots and scenes that were unachievable in the original release due to financial, technological, and time restraints. By far the most controversial change involved Han Solo's abrupt dispatching of bounty hunter Greedo on Tatooine. Jabba the Hutt's exchange with Solo was finally realized as Lucas envisioned it, and the Death Star's spectacular destruction was augmented with a huge expanding ring.
